items.prompt: A study with rain on the window: a man stands beside a table with his right arm extended, his hand entering a vertical shimmering rift in the air up to the wrist; beyond the rift a very tall translucent faceless figure, a single steady amber point glowing in its lower third. A cup of tea steams on the table.

alt.ru: Кабинет, дождь на стекле: мужчина у стола по запястье просунул правую руку в мерцающую вертикальную щель в воздухе; за щелью высокая прозрачная безликая фигура с ровной янтарной точкой внизу; на столе дымится чай.
alt.en: A study with rain on the window: a man by a table has put his right hand into a shimmering vertical rift up to the wrist; beyond it a tall translucent faceless figure with a steady amber point low down; tea steaming on the table.
alt.pt: Um escritório com chuva na janela: um homem junto à mesa enfia a mão direita até o pulso numa fenda vertical cintilante; do outro lado, uma figura alta, translúcida e sem rosto com um ponto âmbar firme embaixo; chá fumegando na mesa.
alt.es: Un estudio con lluvia en la ventana: un hombre junto a la mesa ha metido la mano derecha hasta la muñeca en una grieta vertical centelleante; detrás una figura alta, translúcida y sin rostro con un punto ámbar fijo abajo; té humeando en la mesa.
